what_landed: Two coupled scenarios that arm the holder's static amps, and the derived guard that makes arming them mandatory. The pair engine applies the holder's own amplifiers to the two shapes a retiring family's walk half would re-price -- damage._add_item_active_damage mitigates an item active against state.magic_amp, damage._add_item_proc_damage multiplies its per-proc figure by state.ability_amp -- and survival.pricing.price_declared_packet has neither. Measured over every committed coupled scenario by reading each fight's resolved combat state: magic_amp is 1.12 on the Abyssal Mask holder in mandate_abyssal_curse_roster and 1.0 everywhere else, while ability_amp and basic_amp are 1.0 with an empty owner in all fifteen. A baseline in which every amp reads 1.0 observes only the case that cannot fail. amp_armed_mage_roster -- Ahri with Actualizer, Abyssal Mask, Hextech Rocketbelt and Stormsurge, the Mana Made Real window authored -- arms magic_amp and ability_amp on the two cases Ruling 1 names as its seed fixtures: an Abyssal Mask holder's item active and an Abyssal Mask holder's ability-triggered item proc. hexoptics_basic_amp_carry -- Caitlyn with Hexoptics C44 and Infinity Edge, attacking at full uptime -- arms basic_amp, the third static holder amp, which Ruling 2 names neither of but which the derivation reaches on its own. golden_snapshot.capture_coupled now refuses to capture while any static holder amp is unarmed, reading the amp-kind mapping from the behaviour catalog over every owner in rule_owners() (R-12) rather than from a list typed here, so a fourth amp kind fails the capture on the commit that declares it.

landed_against.rule: R-17/R-32/D-97 -- no baseline moves inside this commit; the capture is the integration agent's own next commit, which is the order Ruling 2 inherits from Amendment L's Ruling 2: scenario, then re-capture, then that family's retirement slice

no_src_change: This slice edits scripts/ and tests/ only. It adds a measurement surface and changes nothing the calculator computes, which is why every leaf below is a new row rather than a moved one.

qualifying_population.rule: R-20's second half. The count is not readable off the pre-change tree by inspection, because a scenario the baseline does not hold has no leaves to inspect. The population is therefore enumerated from the committed artifacts -- scripts/golden_coupled_baseline.json's own fifteen scenario keys and its metadata block -- before the first edit, and any occurrence outside it stops the slice.
qualifying_population.method: A scenario key the committed baseline does not hold is reported by leaf_report ONCE, at the node, as a single absent_to_value membership transition: _leaf_diffs recurses into a mapping only when BOTH sides are mappings, so an absent subtree is never fanned out into leaves that have no counterpart. Two new scenarios are therefore two occurrences and not two subtrees' worth. Beside them, the snapshot's own derived shape counters move because the scenario set gained members: the metadata block publishes four of them, enumerated by name below. This is the same population shape the previous covering-scenario act enumerated, for the same reason and by the same reading.
qualifying_population.no_committed_leaf_moves: Every leaf the committed baseline already holds is untouched: the difference set is exactly the six paths above, so the fifteen scenarios captured before this slice are byte-identical, and scripts/golden_coupled_exact.json reproduces every per-attacker total it already holds.

oracle_pass.why: R-15's amendment of 2026-08-14: a membership transition that is the ruled consequence of a declared change is adjudicated BY CITATION, not by verdict. Both scenario occurrences are absent_to_value as the identity-keyed leaf_report classifies them, which is the amendment's first guard; they are rows a captured snapshot did not hold because the scenario did not exist, not values that moved. The ruling that puts them there is one a reader can open, which is the amendment's second guard: the umbrella's Amendment M, Ruling 2 -- 'The covering scenario set gains, by integration act (R-12, R-32 -- a baseline moves in the integration agent's own commit and never inside a semantic slice), at least one scenario arming magic_amp and one arming ability_amp, so the amp term is observed by the baselines and by the oracles rather than shipping behind a green zero-occurrence line.' No oracle receipt is owed on either, and one may not be filed as though the question were a value question: no cached wiki text and no formula in docs/math-foundations.md decides whether a roster should be measured.
oracle_pass.the_four_shape_counters: They are not behaviour leaves and they are not adjudicable by an oracle: they count the snapshot's own shape, and no cached wiki text decides how many leaves a snapshot has. Umbrella criterion 4 disowns them to docs/receipts/campaign-fingerprints.json, which is their sole home, and the capture commit that moves them carries their one line of cause (R-34). They are listed under coupled_golden_shape_counters rather than beside the behaviour leaves for exactly that reason -- the allowlist mechanism keeps the two apart, and this receipt states no value of any of them.
oracle_pass.what_an_oracle_would_still_be_owed: Any movement of a leaf the committed baseline already holds. There is none: the pair baseline reads 'snapshot identical', and the coupled difference set is the six paths enumerated above and nothing else.

the_third_amp_kind.what_ruling_2_names: magic_amp and ability_amp. The amendment's own measured block records that basic_amp -- the third static holder amp, declared by the only other part-amp declaration in the tree over every owner in rule_owners() -- is named by neither it nor its coverage.
the_third_amp_kind.why_it_is_covered_here_anyway: Because the derivation Ruling 2 orders is what decides the population, and the derivation reaches it. Ruling 2 requires the coverage derivation to READ the amp-kind mapping so that 'a future amp kind that no scenario arms fails the check on the commit that declares it rather than being discovered by whoever next re-prices'. A derivation that read the mapping and then subtracted one of its members by name would be a typed carve-out inside a rule that exists to forbid typed lists, and it would not catch a future kind either, since the exclusion mechanism would be the same list. basic_amp is precisely such an unarmed kind, discovered by the check on the commit that builds it. So the mapping is read whole and every kind in it is armed.
the_third_amp_kind.what_this_does_not_do: It does not widen Ruling 2 and it rules nothing. The requirement stands as written; what is recorded here is that the derivation it orders has three members today, and that all three are armed rather than two armed and one excused.

measured.golden: compare clean -- this slice enters through neither pipeline.run_fight nor any src/ path (R-11).
measured.coupled_golden: 6 differing leaves, 6 qualifying under R-15, all six inside the enumerated population, zero outside it. R-15's ratio clause is not triggered: the differing-leaf count is 0.04% of the numeric leaves, read from the report's own denominator.
measured.one_physical_cause: The coupled scenario set gained two members. Nothing the calculator computes changed, and no leaf that existed before this slice differs.
measured.the_amp_term_itself: Reproduced rather than asserted, on the two seed cases, by dropping the declaring item from the armed roster and re-running it: active_Hextech Rocketbelt and proc_Stormsurge both stand to their unamped selves in the ratio item_effects declares for Abyssal Mask's magic_amp, which is the term Amendment M's measured block says an instrument reproduces exactly. tests/test_golden_snapshot.py::TestHolderAmpCoverage::test_the_magic_amp_is_priced_into_both_seed_rows is that measurement, gated.
